hadiths.text: Rapporté par Abu Huraira رضي الله عنه : Le Messager d’Allah ﷺ a dit : « Si l’un d’entre vous est invité à un repas alors qu’il jeûne, qu’il dise : “Je jeûne.” »

chapter.ara-name: باب الصَّائِمِ يُدْعَى لِطَعَامٍ أَوْ يُقَاتَلُ فَلْيَقُلْ إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
chapter.eng-name: If a fasting person is invited to eat and he does not want to break his fast, or someone insults him or argues with him, it is recommended for him to say: "I am Fasting", and he should protect his fast from obscene speech, ignorance and the like
